behaviors_asserted: A first-party typed RPC client works in edge environments (Cloudflare Workers & Deno Deploy) without Node.js-specific adapters.
The client accepts an injected, environment-aware fetch function for Workers compatibility (e.g., service binding fetch).
The typed client supports streaming RPC responses (SSE / ReadableStream).
HTTPException subtypes (error handling types) are propagated to the client side.
